question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He **is having **a car for five years.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'has had'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase **"for five years"** indicates a duration that started in the past and continues to the present.
 
• For such situations, we use the **Present Perfect Tense**: **has/have + past participle**.
 
• **"Has had"** is the correct present perfect form of the verb "have". (रखा है / से है)
 
• **Example:** She **has had** this job for three years.

**Correct sentence:** *He **has had** a car for five years.*

Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: has** – Simple present tense; does not indicate duration from past to present. (है)
 
• **Option 2: had** – Simple past tense; refers to a completed action in the past. (था)
 
• **Option 4: is having** – Present continuous; generally not used with stative verbs like "have" for possession. (रख रहा है)
